V50 workshop template, based on {{tl|workshop}}

== Usage ==
This automatically includes the page in the "Workshops" category.

The image tries load <code>File:{{{name}}}.png</code> if the image is already in use here on commons (as it is likely is) use <code>|image=another-name</code>. Note: [[screenshot]]s should be at the "native" resolution.
To add a fourth keyboard shortcut for workshops in subcategories, add <code>|key2=xx</code>
